title: ‘Bas aaj ki raat hai zindagi’: Song Ketan danced to now carries painful irony
summary: The singer, Reetu Sharma, who performed at the event on May 7, shared a poignant video that highlights the joyous atmosphere juxtaposed against the sorrow following Agarwal's purported murder on June 18.
